subject: Re: is this problem better dealt with now rather than later?
summary: Later, but with a date. The four cache copies work today and none has misbehaved; the only cost of waiting is that a future change to one of them could drift from the others. Doing it now would spend a builder slot during the week we are shipping 1.0.1, the self-healing loop and the training copilot, for no change you would see on a ticket. My suggestion: tie this one, and take it together with proposal 20 (the vocabulary caching consolidation) as a single item in the first quiet slot after the training copilot lands, because both touch the same cache code and one test pass covers both. If you want it sooner anyway, vote for and I will queue it right after WP21.
details: Four mtime-keyed caches: citations (index, caps_vocabulary, generic_words), gates (worldmodel sections), precedents (playbooks, siblings), kayako_client (macros). A shared mtime_cache(path_or_dir, build) helper removes ~80 lines and one staleness-bug class (a cache keyed on the wrong mtime). Regression risk is low with the existing tests, but the change touches every pre-turn step at once, which is why I would not land it mid-batch.
